jobs.occupation: Senior System Engineer Architecture (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Design authority for the system level architecture baseline
- Analyse the customer requirements, external and internal systems’ needs, and missions needs
- Support the customer in defining requirements baseline
- Define architecture options for trade-studies that can full-fill customer mission objectives based on own knowledge
- Perform system level trade-offs and system performance budgets
- Define, maintain and pilot data-driven systems architectures
- Technical coordination of multi-disciplinary engineering teams to deliver a consistent and scalable mission solution
- Ensure coherence between the mission objectives and user capability requirements
- Negotiate the solution(s) OHB internal with (technical) project management, technical team
- Negotiate the solution(s) external with stakeholder(s) and other companies
- Specify the selected solution / option for the requirements break-down
- Plan, Organize and manage the supporting team of experts
- For the area of responsibility responsible for project performance (schedule, cost, quality) as part of the project success
- Define, develop and verify needed tool chain(s) for architecture trades
- Technical leadership of internal research and development/research and technology projects
- Work in an international team of experts from OHB and project partners
Your Qualifications

- Successfully completed studies (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering, electronics, software development or equivalent qualification
- Several years of experience in system-of-systems architecture design for space projects
- Ideally several years of professional experience in defence and security systems
- Very good understanding of several space sensing domains (mainly electro-optical)
- Technical leadership and accountability
- Strong competence in self-organizing and work planning
- High motivation, pro-active working approach, and strong sense of responsibility
- Strong competence in working in a multicultural team
- Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills
- Ability and willingness to achieve a German security clearance
- Fluency in both spoken and written English
- Willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: Space Systems Engineer Architect (m/f/d) Mechanical, Thermal & Propulsion (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Your task will be to lead a large team of experts without disciplinary function to design, manufacture and test complex spacecrafts
- You will be responsible for mechanical design, structure analysis, thermal analysis & design and propulsion analysis & design as the architect of these subsystems
- Reporting and controlling costs and schedule are an integral part of the work
- You will be in direct communication with the suppliers, the project team and the customer
- Ensure configuration through consistent use of change management
- Perform requirement flow-down to the subsystem specifications and write subsystem specification
- Manage the complexes interdisciplinary interfaces between the different subsystems, both within your domain and towards the other subsystem of the spacecraft
- Support supplier and system level reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, QAR…) in a leading role
- Support the main campaigns of the project (EVT, Launch, LEOP) in a support role
Your Qualifications

- Master's Degree in Engineering or equivalent
- Several years of experience is mandatory
- Experience in system engineering is preferred
- Several years of experience in at least one of technical domains (mechanical design, structure analysis, thermal or propulsion) is mandatory
- Deep knowledge of satellite architectures is greatly beneficial for the position
- Self-managed, pro-active, solution oriented
- Ability to take decisions, solution oriented, pragmatic
- Ability to team leadership as well as work in a team
- Working level proficiency in written and spoken English, other language skills advantageous

Your Tasks

- Design, sizing, verification and validation of thermal control systems according to customer requirements and feasibility with regard to manufacturing, integration, cost, schedule, quality and risk
- Thermal analysis including thermal modelling, verification, validation and assessment of analysis results
- Support of thermal hardware definition and its implementation and verification
- Support of reviews (from system to equipment level) and presentation of work results to internal and external customers
- Support of system engineers during design, development and implementation at system and sub-system level
- Preparation and execution of thermal tests in cooperation with AIT including creation of test specifications and definition of test conditions and test set up including ground support equipment as well as verification and validation of test results
- Generation and maintenance of thermal control system documentation
Your Qualifications

- Degree in engineering with a major in aerospace engineering or comparable qualifications
- Several years of professional experience in space thermal engineering is preferred
- Experience in the design of thermal control systems, spacecraft thermal engineering and analysis for spacecraft is preferred
- Strong problem-solving skills
- High motivation and proactive involvement with a strong passion for space and spacecraft engineering
- Strong communication and negotiation skills (preferably English and German)
- Experience in subcontractor management is preferred
- In-depth knowledge of ESATAN-TMS, or a similar thermal analysis software
- Used to work in an international environment

jobs.occupation: Propulsion Test Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Support space projects in the development, integration, and testing of propulsion systems from proposal phase through launch campaign
- Prepare test procedures and test plans, and perform gaseous, liquid, and electrical functional testing of satellite propulsion systems, equipment, and demonstrators
- Develop, build, maintain, and continuously improve test stands for development programs and test execution
- Specify, procure, assemble, and maintain test and measurement equipment
- Perform filling, pressurization, and drying operations on propulsion systems and related subassemblies
- Plan, supervise, and execute system-level tests at production facilities, test centers, and launch sites
- Provide test engineering expertise to subsystem engineering teams, present test results to projects and customers, and contribute to future satellite project proposals
- Handle hazardous materials and dangerous goods in compliance with safety requirements
Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical field
- Hands-on experience in Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT), ideally with propulsion system testing
- Solid understanding of hydraulic and pneumatic systems, including their static and dynamic behavior
- Experience in writing test procedures; knowledge of data acquisition software scripting, automated test equipment, and handling hazardous gases/liquids is an advantage
- Strong willingness to learn and quickly understand new and complex technical topics
- Hands-on, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to think creatively and work both independently and flexibly
- Willingness to travel and work outside regular business hours when required
- Strong teamwork and communication skills, fluent English, German language skills advantageous, and a valid Class B driving license (car)

Job description

In order to support our Digital Transformation team, Airbus is looking for a

ERP(SAP) Platform & Infrastructure Technical Expert (m/w/d)

The Mission & Scope

Airbus Aerostructures is pioneering its digital transformation, and we are seeking a proactive SAP Technical Expert with a strong leadership mindset. You will bridge architectural vision and hands-on execution, ensuring seamless business continuity across our legacy systems while steering operational readiness for our S/4HANA Cloud transition.

Scope: Core ERP, EWM, GTS, Technical Solutions, S/4HANA Cloud, and SAP BTP.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Operations (On-Premise & Cloud): Act as the primary technical SME and lead deep-level administration, HANA DB optimization, trace analysis, and central infrastructure orchestration (Cloud Connectors, Web Dispatchers, STMS/ChaRM, SSO) across hybrid environments.
- Advanced S/4HANA Operations & Migrations: Lead S/4HANA conversion activities—including advanced SUM/DMO transitions—and manage S/4HANA Cloud testing landscapes, system refreshes, and target provisioning.
- Lifecycle Management, Monitoring & Automation: Drive system enhancements and release cycles, manage high-availability/disaster recovery setups, implement observability frameworks (SAP Cloud ALM / BTP), and design Infrastructure-as-Code workflows to automate standard BASIS routines.
- Security, Compliance & Audit Readiness: Enforce system hardening, patch orchestration, and SSL/TLS certificate management. Monitor security/gateway logs, remediate vulnerabilities, and lead technical preparations for internal and external SAP audits in alignment with cybersecurity standards.
- Project Management & Service Leadership: Ideate, steer, and deliver complex technical projects to optimize ERP performance and transformations. Drive continuous improvement in partner service delivery and manage connectivity pipelines (REST/SOAP/RFC APIs, SAP Event Mesh) across cross-functional teams.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Degree in Computer Science / Business Informatics OR a vocational degree as an IT Specialist with proven advanced training.
- Experience & Mindset: Multi-year track record in SAP BASIS and platform infrastructure administration for complex hybrid landscapes, paired with a project-leading mindset.
- Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP HANA DB (Linux/Windows), SAP BTP, Cloud Connector, and SAP Cloud ALM.
- Communication: Excellent stakeholder management skills in complex, matrixed organizations.
- Languages: Proficient in English; German language skills are a strong advantage

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology. Starting date: as soon as possible, at the latest September 1,2026.

Area of responsibility

The Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology aims to recruit a highly motivated post-doctoral scientistto join the Cell Biology group, headed by Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk. We study how ubiquitination andautophagy control cell survival, programmed cell death, inflammation and cell differentiation inbroad pathophysiological settings, including oncology and infection. For this, human and animalpre-clinical experimental systems, including cell lines, primary cells, organoids and iPSC-derivedcells, will be integrated with cell biology with biochemistry, molecular biology and omicsapproaches, including CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, super-resolution and confocal microscopy andmass-spectrometry. For examples of recent research, see Wächtershäuser et al, Signal TransductTarget Ther, 11(1):204; Zein et al, Autophagy, 21(5):1075-1095 and Weinelt et al, Cell Death Dis,15(1):77.

The position will be closely involved in shaping the research group, setting up the lab and planningand performing independent research at the interface of cell biology, biochemistry and molecularbiology with imaging and computational data analysis. The successful candidate will play centralroles in collaborations between different scientific and clinical research groups and in developinginnovative approaches in comparative cell biology to improve animal and human health. Theposition furthermore combines opportunities for teaching, scientific and academic qualification(Habilitation) and the development of independent research projects within the scope of the group.

Key Focus Areas:

• Independent experimental scientific research in comparative cell biology.

• Teaching and supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD students/Habilitation.

• Coordination of lab setup and daily running.

• Contribution to the development and implementation of integrative analytical approaches forcell biology, biochemistry and molecular biology, incl. multi-omics, CRISPR/Cas-basedapproaches, imaging and bioinformatic image analysis.

• Support in the analysis of large datasets (e.g., RNA-seq, single-cell data and imaging).

• Support in the preparation of scientific publications and grant applications, for example for theGerman Research Foundation.

• Organization of scientific exchange activities, workshops and project meetings.

Recruitment requirements:

• A university degree and doctoral degree/PhD in (Molecular) Cell Biology, Biochemistry, MolecularBiology, Biology, Veterinary Medicine ("Approbation"), or a related discipline.

• Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills.

• Experience with, or strong interest in, multiscale imaging, CRISPR/Cas-based methods andprimary cell/tissue culture (organoids).

• Basic knowledge in the analysis of high-dimensional biological datasets, particularly microscopicdatasets.

• Knowledge of additional disciplines, including systems biology, gene regulation, epigenomics ormultiscale data integration, is advantageous.

Required professional knowledge and personal skills:

• Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts across disciplinary boundaries.

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working style.

• Excellent organizational, communication and teamwork skills.

• Willingness to contribute to scientific coordination, develop independent research questions andparticipate in the preparation of publications and grant applications.

• Curious, strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills combined with the ability to developinnovative solutions.

• Flexibility and willingness to rapidly familiarize oneself with new technologies and researchareas.

Job Description

About the role

As a Product Quality Engineer, you will be expected to step into the game and display your excellent quality mindset to help drive our innovations beyond industry standards

What you will do

- Represent the Quality Management within the development team
- Correlate the SiC failure mechanisms with reliability measures to be implemented into the product quality
- Support the definition and execution of qualification activities for SiC product developments
- Contribute to the implementation of quality procedures and quality standards (Nexperia, JEDEC, AEC, and customer-specific) within projects
- Support the development, review, and verification of final test specifications
- Promote quality awareness and best practices to internal and external stakeholders
- Support customer requests and complaints handling activities
- Contribute to the identification and resolution of quality gaps in the product creation process
- Support the definition of qualification requirements and qualification of manufacturing processes
- Maintain documentation and handle data in analysis tools for Reliability, Yield, FMEA, Customer Requests, and related activities
- Perform analyses to identify root causes of yield loss or production issues and support the implementation of containment and corrective actions
- Prepare initial input for PCNs, support review and release activities, and contribute to follow-up actions

What you will need

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Physics or a similar discipline
- Experience in a similar position is desirable and experienced in wafer fab and assembly processes preferred
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications in the SiC domain
- First knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High-quality mindset and ability to work under pressure
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities

About the role

At Nexperia, we build around 100 billion essential semiconductors a year. These microchips are a crucial part of cars, mobiles, watches, white goods, mobility solutions – you name it. It is more than likely that all your gadgets carry one or more Nexperia chips.

We are headquartered in the Netherlands and have Frontend and Backend production sites across the globe.

Our Procurement is organized in a global matrix structure. We are an international team equipped with many years of solid industry knowledge and you will find it easy to integrate in our team if you identify with our working principles: take ownership, drive with perseverance, be efficient, and enjoy what you do.

We are searching for a Global Sourcing Manager for our Global NPR Team.

In this role you will

- be accountable for selected global NPR (non-product related) subcategories, such as People & Professional, IT, Utilities Management and others purchased for specific or all our Nexperia sites.
- develop robust and long-term sourcing strategies and roadmaps for the categories you own based on key suppliers, market position, technology capabilities, pricing development, and risk mitigation – in alignment with sr. leadership and key stakeholders.
- be building and nurturing long-term supplier partnerships focusing on the 4-Buy Principle (Buy Right, Buy Low, Buy Little, Buy On-Time) and Nexperia procurement processes, achieving best total cost of ownership for Nexperia.
- manage supplier performance for best-in-class supply base.
- drive synergy spends to consolidate count of suppliers and drive costs down on e.g. consumables.
- actively involving yourself in system and process related improvement projects.
- drive and support stakeholder management on procurement processes.
- give support to team colleagues as well as development to the team.

Ideally you have

- a commercial degree and >10 years of experience in semiconductor or similar industries.
- proven track record of sourcing roles.
- excellent English speaking and communication skills amongst various groups of stakeholders, also across borders (Tier 1+2 sites).
- proven negotiation and analytical skills.
- capability of thinking out of the box while continuously challenging the status quo.
